products.title: Storytold Craft Overview
products.purpose: Route AI-operated creative work to the correct Storytold product and coordinate CLI/MCP workflows without assuming a shared API.
hazards: The twelve editors share ideas, not one CLI grammar, parameter schema or sandbox policy.
A repository capability is not necessarily present in an installed release.
ArtCraft, ArtCraft-X and the launcher do not have a comparable operator CLI verified here.

products.title: PhotoCraft
products.purpose: Edit layered raster images, PSD/PSB documents, masks, adjustments, smart objects and exports through PhotoCraft.
hazards: CLI --cmd takes a separate --params; do not import another app's id=JSON grammar.
Direct CLI paths are ambient; scoped MCP/serve use separately granted read and write authority.
An MCP batch is not atomic; response-budget errors may occur after an edit.
Save smart-object contents inward-to-outward before saving the parent document.

products.title: LightCraft
products.purpose: Operate a persistent photo catalog, develop RAW files, manage originals/sidecars, and export images with LightCraft.
hazards: A library has one owning process; use connect mode rather than opening it twice.
CLI render defaults to full size, while the MCP export helper defaults to a 3000-pixel long edge.
Move import changes original files; undo does not put them back.
White-balance scale and develop process version are part of the image specification.

products.title: VectorCraft
products.purpose: Create and transform vector documents, inspect objects, control live appearance and export artboards with VectorCraft.
hazards: Bare mcp tries a live app before falling back; specify --headless for deterministic isolation.
--artboard is zero-based; --range is one-based.
Scoped MCP root flags imply headless and cannot be combined with --connect.
Import warnings can indicate lost content; do not bypass --replace-lossy protections casually.

products.title: FilmCraft
products.purpose: Inspect, edit and render video projects and timelines with FilmCraft, including media health, timing and export jobs.
hazards: Time uses 254016000000 ticks per second; never confuse ticks, frames and seconds.
Headless MCP has ambient filesystem access; PhotoCraft root flags are not accepted.
Engine/MCP export can succeed while drawing offline-media placeholders; inspect offlineMedia.
Breaking a stdout pipe does not cancel execution or a pending save.

products.title: EffectCraft
products.purpose: Build motion graphics, animate composition/layer properties, manage expressions and render jobs with EffectCraft.
hazards: Keyframe writes default to layer time; explicit comp time must be requested.
batch and command_batch have different rollback and undo semantics.
A render owns a snapshot; edits made during rendering do not change that render.
Scoped mode restricts scripts and UI driving as well as filesystem paths.

products.title: DesignCraft
products.purpose: Compose page-layout documents with threaded stories, frames, styles, images and publication exports in DesignCraft.
hazards: Story offsets are UTF-8 bytes, not Unicode character indexes.
Geometry is spread-space points, y down; rendered page indexes are zero-based.
--page, --scale and --pdf-options apply to the exports that follow them.
Rendered text is not proof that every story fits; inspect overset.

products.title: PdfCraft
products.purpose: Read, inspect, organize, annotate, edit, secure and verify PDFs through PdfCraft's CLI and schema-described automation tools.
hazards: Pages and positions are one-based; geometry uses displayed-page top-left PDF points.
Document IDs belong to a live session; use one run script or persistent MCP for multistep edits.
Strict task-tool schemas differ from command_run, which can warn and ignore unknown nested keys.
Incremental saves retain previous bytes; overlays and successful renders do not establish secure redaction.

products.title: WordCraft
products.purpose: Write, revise and review structured documents with WordCraft, preserving style, tracked changes and export intent.
hazards: review.trackChanges without value toggles; use value:true for reliable enabling.
Unknown CharProps/ParaProps fields may be ignored; inspect the result.
Headless filesystem roots cannot be applied to --connect; the reviewed desktop has no equivalent roots.
Do not assume --help works on every subcommand; use the verified commands catalog.

products.title: GridCraft
products.purpose: Inspect and edit spreadsheets, evaluate formulas, validate calculation oracles and measure workbook round-trip fidelity using GridCraft.
hazards: XLSB and ODS import may turn formulas into cached values and omit formatting.
check exit zero is not comprehensive formula coverage: inspect noOracle, volatile and checked counts.
Preserve formulas separately from displayed values and data types.
CLI run stops on the first failing step; do not assume transaction rollback.

products.title: DeckCraft
products.purpose: Build, inspect and export presentations with DeckCraft while preserving editable shapes, slide structure and presentation intent.
hazards: A PNG conversion can cover only the first slide; use render --all for coverage.
A static render does not verify animation, transitions or embedded media playback.
Use --save for the editable working document and explicit exports for deliveries.
Do not assume generic --help flags or schema parity with another Craft app.

products.title: CADCraft
products.purpose: Create and verify drawings with CADCraft using geometry commands, structured inspection, layouts and DXF/DWG interchange.
hazards: Unsupported imported entity types are not necessarily retained on save.
Model-space units, paper-space points and viewport scale are distinct.
Command-prompt workflows are stateful; inspect pending prompts before sending another command.
SVG/PNG visual similarity does not establish dimensional or CAD round-trip correctness.

products.title: SoundCraft
products.purpose: Operate multitrack audio sessions, source media, mixing, routing, automation and offline bounces with SoundCraft.
hazards: Headless MCP has no audio device; transport success is not evidence of audible output.
A .scraft session depends on its Audio Files directory and media availability.
session.audio_health is not a loudness, routing or plugin-quality audit.
save_session requires replace:true to overwrite another existing file.

products.title: ArtCraft
products.purpose: Inspect and integrate Storytold ArtCraft's generative desktop workflow and Rust client without inventing a Craft-style operator CLI.
hazards: No comparable artcraft-cli operator surface was verified in the reviewed sources.
A Rust HTTP endpoint binding is not a supported public automation API contract by itself.
Generation can upload user content and incur provider costs; authorize those effects explicitly.

products.title: ArtCraft-X
products.purpose: Understand and integrate the experimental ArtCraft-X Tauri generation application, its IPC boundary and development lifecycle.
hazards: The Vite development port is not a generation REST API.
A registered Tauri invoke handler is not an externally reachable MCP or CLI endpoint.
Development startup and hot reload must not be mistaken for durable production job management.

products.title: Craft Launcher
products.purpose: Manage discovery, installation, version compatibility and safe update handoffs for Storytold Craft applications via the ArtCraft Launcher.
hazards: The product executable is artcraft-launcher; a craft-launcher-cli management API was not verified.
Installing a GUI does not prove that a compatible CLI is on PATH, especially on macOS.
Package formats, elevation and sandbox paths differ across platforms.
